what: Per-layer weight quantization error against the original checkpoint weights

metric.rel_fro: ||W_hat - W||_F / ||W||_F, fp32 weights, float64 accumulation, original basis
metric.max_abs: max |W_hat - W| in the original basis, in weight units
metric.rel_fro_pooled: sqrt(sum of squared errors / sum of squared weights) over the layers in scope
metric.bits_per_weight: stored bytes of codes and scales (and codebook) times 8 over N*K

formats.int8_rowwise: INT8, per-row absmax/127 fp32 scale, no rotation
formats.int8_convrot: INT8 per-row after Hadamard-256 ConvRot rotation
formats.w4a8: 4-bit, ConvRot-256, group 16, Lloyd-Max codebook, e4m3 group scales, int8 grid decode
formats.w6a8: 6-bit uniform, ConvRot-256, group 16, searched e4m3 group scales, int8 grid decode
formats.gguf_q4_k: ggml_quantize_chunk Q4_K without importance matrix, decoded with gguf-py
formats.shipped_int8_convrot: the publisher's INT8 ConvRot tensors, dequantized as stored

environment.container: Modal debian_slim, python 3.12, 4 CPU, 8 GiB per job

int8_convrot.skipped: K=64 is not a multiple of the ConvRot group 256

w4a8.skipped: K=64 is not a multiple of the ConvRot group 256

w6a8.skipped: K=64 is not a multiple of the ConvRot group 256

gguf_q4_k.skipped: K=64 is not a multiple of the 256-value block

summary_note: pairwise_layer_counts, w4a8_codebook_layers and shipped_int8_convrot_vs_ours were added to the summary after the run by re-running summarize() on the saved layer rows; no measurement was repeated
